hook: LEFT JOIN: koi customer [[peeche nahi]] chhootega

slides.title: LEFT = [[left ki saari]]
slides.note: Class photo: **sab bachche** aayenge, trophy ho ya na ho 📸

slides.title: LEFT JOIN [[likho]]
slides.code:
SELECT c.name, o.amount
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o
  ON c.id = o.customer_id;

slides.title: Sab [[aa gaye]]
slides.note: Kabir, Riya ka order nahi, phir bhi **list mein hain**. Amount = NULL

slides.title: Kisne [[order nahi]] kiya?
slides.code:
SELECT c.name
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o
  ON c.id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.customer_id IS NULL;
slides.note: Result: **Kabir, Riya**. Marketing team ko discount bhejo 💌

slides.title: Filter [[kahan]] lagao?
points: Right table pe filter → **ON mein** daalo
Left table ka filter → WHERE chalega ✅
slides.note: WHERE o.amount > 400 → NULL wale gaye, LEFT bana **INNER** 😬

slides.why: WHERE NULL rows hata deta → LEFT JOIN chupke se **INNER** ban gaya
